dictionary_evidence.current_income_match: CE last-12-month before-tax CU income mean/coarse band vs SCE supplied household income category; CU/household boundaries and original SCE categorisation not fully equivalent.
dictionary_evidence.assets: Only housing tenure is used; it is not home value, housing equity, liquid assets or net wealth. No common measured asset variable is available in the current matching whitelist.
dictionary_evidence.do_not_infer: Income matching does not imply wealth matching; two-week imputation category changes are not economic income transitions.

pooled_equal_quarter_source.method: Each quarter normalized to equal unconditional CU source mass; same current fallback/minimums, not an official CE estimate.
